name: Latent segmentation utility in SAM2 memory attention preregistration v2
status: frozen before DAVIS validation and PolypGen test experiments
hypothesis: SAM2 memory representations encode current segmentation utility. Attention follows that utility under clean memory, drifts under accumulated memory errors while utility remains decodable, and a minimal frozen-feature readout can restore useful allocation.
claim_policy: Use latent-capability wording only if behavioral, representational, and causal evidence all pass their preregistered bars.

M4.name: random-initialized memory attention and memory encoder
M4.role: E4 probe control; image encoder and SAM heads are not evidence for this control

common_protocol.memory: conditioning frame plus six recent non-conditioning frames, object pointers enabled
common_protocol.prediction_rule: emit a mask for every frame, including absent-object frames
common_protocol.cache_rule: cache image-encoder features once per sequence and restore an immutable pre-target memory state for every counterfactual
common_protocol.tuning_rule: no threshold, feature choice, checkpoint, lambda, or hyperparameter is selected on DAVIS validation or PolypGen

davis_train.sequence_partition_rule: reuse the already frozen explicit DAVIS train, holdout, and validation sequence lists; v2 changes the hypothesis and model, not the split

davis_val.use: locked in-domain test with official J&F

polypgen.use: locked zero-shot endoscopic test; empty-GT sequences contribute only false-positive rate

sanity_checks.reference: M1 DAVIS validation J&F must be within one point of the pinned official SAM2 implementation under the identical first-frame-mask protocol
sanity_checks.no_op: an all-zero additive attention bias must leave prediction logits bit-identical
sanity_checks.cached_restore: restoring the cached pre-target state must reproduce baseline logits bit-identically
sanity_checks.attention_reconstruction: projected and RoPE-encoded QK-softmax-V must reproduce each cross-attention module output with maximum absolute error below 1e-5

units.regional: 4x4 spatial blocks within each memory frame on selected frames
units.pointers: each object-pointer token is a separate unit and is always reported separately

utility.definition: soft Dice loss with unit excluded minus baseline soft Dice loss; positive means helpful
utility.hard_metric: baseline hard-mask Dice minus excluded hard-mask Dice, recorded separately
utility.operator: additive negative-infinity mask on excluded keys through scaled_dot_product_attention without changing key/value layout or RoPE positions

measurements.attention_saliency: mean cross-attention weight from predicted-foreground current queries to unit keys, averaged over heads; preserve per-layer values

corruption.c1: random boundary erosion or dilation by 3 pixels at memory resolution
corruption.c2: c1 plus translation by 5-10 percent of object width and height
corruption.c3: c2 plus deletion of 20-30 percent of object area
corruption.c4: c3 plus a false-positive blob on the most similar distractor region
corruption.natural: normal self-predicted memory, also stratified at target frame index above 60

experiments.E1: light failure taxonomy with oracle prompt, construction, and negative-utility exclusion
experiments.E2: frame-level oracle bank, oracle attention, both, and oracle construction; propagate for 5, 10, and 20 frames; compare each oracle with best-of-N random search of identical cardinality and evaluation budget
experiments.E3: per-frame and per-layer attention-utility agreement under c0, c1, c2, c3, c4, natural, and natural-late memory
experiments.E4: held-out-sequence linear sign/rank probes, rank-at-most-16 bilinear probe, and reference MLP using frozen q, k, v, logits, and pointer features
experiments.E5: frozen-model attention-logit bias with lambda selected only on DAVIS-train holdout; compare base, SAM2Long, Lean-style, competitive query-conditioned gate, budget-matched corrupted-rollout attention fine-tuning, random direction, shuffled labels, linear, bilinear, MLP, and oracle
experiments.E6: temporal failure statistics and gain by horizon
experiments.E7: DAVIS-trained readout applied zero-shot to PolypGen; clean-versus-corrupted behavior; MedSAM2 transfer
experiments.E8: granularity, feature, probe, label-source, layer, pointer, and sparse-label ablations
experiments.E9: parameters, FPS, peak memory, label-generation GPU-hours, qualitative failures, and negative cases

evidence_bars.E2_attention_share: at least 0.33, significant over best-of-N, and oracle-attention gain comparable to oracle-bank gain
evidence_bars.E3: significant negative c0-c4 trend and significantly positive rho(c0)-rho(natural)
evidence_bars.E4: linear or bilinear AUROC significantly above the best trivial and existing criterion on held-out sequences and the low-agreement subset, with every control passing
evidence_bars.E5: linear readout significantly beats M1 and the best hand-designed baseline on failure-episode frames, causes no significant loss on success frames, and achieves at least 70 percent of the MLP gain

statistics.aggregation: average frames within each sequence before comparisons
statistics.E3: Spearman per frame with sequence bootstrap; corruption trend by linear mixed model with corruption fixed and sequence random

decision_framework.low_clean_agreement: no latent-capability claim; learned supervision only if E5 MLP succeeds
decision_framework.E2_attention_share_below_bar: stop method branch and pivot to dominant selection or construction cause
